The robot sits at the center facing right, in a 6 m by 6 m square. Color is the metric length of the constant-twist motion to each position, with the cheapest arrival heading. Each weight multiplies a squared rate, so the shares split the squared cost. Move the pointer over the square to draw the motion and the robot along it.
